learning_objective: 🎯 Master the art of managing time, money, and energy! Learn the steps of the management process to achieve your goals efficiently.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Resources are the tools we use to achieve our goals. They are limited. They can be Human (time, energy, skills, knowledge) or Non-Human/Material (money, land, equipment, community facilities).
Because resources are limited and our wants are unlimited, we must manage them. Good management means getting the maximum benefit out of the minimum resources without wasting them.
The first step of the management process. It involves setting a goal, listing the available resources, and deciding on a course of action before actually doing the work.
Organizing means assembling the resources and assigning tasks. Implementing (or controlling) means putting the plan into action and making adjustments if things go wrong.
The final step. After the task is done, you look back and check if you achieved your goal. This helps you learn from mistakes and plan better for the future.

fun_activity.title: ⏳ The 24-Hour Pie Chart
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a circle representing your 24-hour day. Divide it into slices showing how you spend your 'Time Resource' (Sleep, School, Phone, Study). Are you managing this resource well?

exam_tips: 📌 Always categorize Time and Energy as 'Human Resources' and Money as a 'Non-Human Resource'.
📌 Memorize the 4 steps of the management process in exact order: Planning -> Organizing -> Implementing/Controlling -> Evaluation.
📌 Remember the core characteristic of resources: They are always limited/scarce.
quick_recap: ⭐ Management is using what you have to get what you want.
⭐ Time is the only resource that is equally distributed (everyone gets 24 hours), but it cannot be saved.
⭐ Evaluation is essential for improving future performance.
